about.missionText: VivaMama is here to support you through pregnancy and after birth with clear, reliable, and personalized guidance. Every feature is designed to help you understand your changing body, care for yourself, and know when to seek help.
about.trustText: Our AI is built using trusted medical information and is supervised by experts, so you receive safe and responsible support. Your privacy always comes first.
about.builtByMoms: Built by a Mom, for Moms
about.originsText: Created by Wellness Emporio and founded by a doctor mom who has walked this journey herself, VivaMama offers 24/7 guidance, weekly check-ins, recovery tracking, expert consultations, and ongoing care support so you feel confident and cared for every step of the way.

aboutVivaAI.title: About Viva AI
aboutVivaAI.paragraph1: Viva AI is a medically-grounded health assistant for your perinatal and motherhood journey. It's trained on a medically verified knowledge base built from thousands of authoritative sources, and its responses are reviewed for accuracy - so the guidance you get is evidence-based and clinically sound.
aboutVivaAI.paragraph2: Every answer is grounded in you: your personal details, your context, and your specific needs, so the support feels relevant rather than generic.
aboutVivaAI.paragraph3: Your privacy is protected at every step. Your conversations with Viva are fully anonymized, no personal identifiers or details are ever shared with third parties, and while Viva uses aggregate analytics to keep improving, it never learns from or trains on your personal data.
aboutVivaAI.whatYouCanAskDesc: Ask Viva anything about your lactation and perinatal needs -from breastfeeding and nutrition to mental health, emotional wellbeing, gynaecological concerns, and new born care. With its specialized, evidence-based medical knowledge base, Viva gives you scientifically sound answers you can trust to make informed decisions about your and your baby's health.

aboutScore.whatIs: What is the Viva Recovery Score?
aboutScore.intro1: The Viva Recovery Score is a holistic metric designed to help you track your postpartum recovery journey. It combines insights from your physical, emotional, and lactation well-being, gathered through your weekly self check-ins.
aboutScore.intro2: By completing your check-ins, VivaMama is able to provide you with a high-level view of your progress, allowing you to reflect on areas where you might need more rest, care, or support.
aboutScore.howCalculatedBody: Your score is based entirely on the responses you provide during your weekly assessments. The algorithm weighs your physical healing, emotional state, and breastfeeding experiences to generate a personalized snapshot of your current week.
aboutScore.reflects: Your Viva Recovery Score reflects how you are feeling this week based on your self check-in responses. It is a personal wellness reflection tool, not a medical assessment.

vivaScore.howGeneratedTitle: How your Viva Score is created
vivaScore.howGeneratedSubtitle: Four simple steps, every week, to track your recovery.
vivaScore.howGeneratedBody: Your Viva Score comes from your weekly check-ins with Viva. Based on your answers, a trained algorithm calculates your score and updates it on your dashboard. These regular updates help you <bold>monitor your progress, notice patterns, and make informed choices</bold> about your recovery.

steps.step1Body: Tap Check In on your dashboard each week.
steps.step2Body: Viva asks a few gentle questions about how you are feeling and recovering.
steps.step3Body: A trained algorithm turns your answers into your Viva Score.
steps.step4Body: Your score updates on your dashboard, so you can track your progress over time.

vivaScore.disclaimer1: Disclaimer: Your Viva Recovery Score reflects how you are feeling this week based on your self check-in responses. It is a personal wellness reflection tool, not a medical assessment.
vivaScore.disclaimer2: VivaMama is not a medical device. The Recovery Score does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical condition. It does not replace advice from a qualified healthcare professional.
vivaScore.disclaimer3: Any suggestions you receive based on your check-in are educational and general in nature, not personalised medical advice.
vivaScore.disclaimer4: If you have any health concern, please speak with your doctor or a qualified healthcare professional. In an emergency, contact emergency services immediately.
vivaScore.noProgressYet: Complete a weekly check-in to start tracking your progress.
